title: Boltzmann Constant, Root Mean Square Speed and Heat Capacities
notes: **Boltzmann constant:** $k_B = R/N_A = 1.38 \times 10^{-23}\,\text{J/K}$. It connects microscopic and macroscopic thermodynamics.
**RMS speed:** $v_{rms} = \sqrt{\frac{3RT}{M}}$, where $M$ is molar mass in kg/mol. At STP, $v_{rms}$ for air is about 485 m/s.
**Most probable speed:** $v_p = \sqrt{\frac{2RT}{M}}$. The speed at which the Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution peaks.
**Mean speed:** $v_{mean} = \sqrt{\frac{8RT}{\pi M}}$. The average speed of all molecules.
**Heat capacities:** for a monatomic ideal gas, $C_V = \frac{3}{2}R$ and $C_P = \frac{5}{2}R$. The ratio $\gamma = C_P/C_V = 5/3 \approx 1.67$.
